target.title: fix(nostr): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Nostr outbound adapter (`extensions/nostr/src/gateway.ts:nostrOutboundAdapter`) had no `sanitizeText` hook. Core delivery (`src/infra/outbound/deliver.ts:889-896`) only runs the per-channel assistant-text sanitizer when the adapter provides one; without it, internal assistant tool-trace scaffolding is delivered verbatim into Nostr DMs. Users see raw banners like tool-failure markers and raw `<tool_call>`/`<function_response>` XML in their direct messages.

## Why This Change Was Made

- **Root cause:** the outbound adapter omits the `sanitizeText` hook that strips internal runtime scaffolding before delivery, and the adapter's narrowed `Pick` type did not even include the field.
- **Fix:** add `sanitizeText` to the `NostrOutboundAdapter` `Pick` type and wire `sanitizeText: ({ text }) => sanitizeAssistantVisibleText(text)` into the adapter — the identical one-line hook already shipped to 13 sibling channels: twitch (#103109), mattermost (#98693), feishu (#98705), signal (#97360), slack (#97367), matrix (#97372), irc (#97214), telegram, googlechat (#90684), qqbot (#90132), discord, whatsapp (#71830), and sms.

## User Impact

Internal tool-trace banners and leaked XML scaffolding no longer reach Nostr DM recipients. Ordinary assistant prose is preserved unchanged.

## Linked context

N/A (no existing issue). Sibling fixes: #103109, #98693, #98705.

## Evidence

Terminal capture of `node --import tsx` runtime verification calling the **patched adapter hook** `nostrOutboundAdapter.sanitizeText` (the exact hook added by this PR) on the exact PR head:

```
hook exists: true
[PASS] tool-trace banner: "Done."
[PASS] xml tool-call: "DM delivered."
[PASS] plain prose: "The relay has 2 active subscriptions."
```

This calls the real `nostrOutboundAdapter.sanitizeText` (the `sanitizeText: ({ text }) => sanitizeAssistantVisibleText(text)` added to the exported adapter in `gateway.ts`), proving the patched Nostr adapter routes assistant text through the sanitizer before delivery.

| # | Field | Value |
|---|-------|-------|
| 1 | Behavior or issue addressed | Nostr outbound delivers internal tool-trace scaffolding verbatim (no sanitizeText hook). |
| 2 | Real environment tested | Linux x64, Node 22; the patched adapter hook invoked on the exact PR head (e143dd3b16e7). |
| 3 | Exact steps or command run | `node --import tsx` script that imports `nostrOutboundAdapter` and calls `sanitizeText` directly, plus colocated vitest `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/<channel>/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts`. |
| 4 | Evidence after fix | Terminal output above: the patched adapter hook strips banners, XML tool-call scaffolding, while preserving ordinary prose. |
| 5 | Observed result after fix | The channel outbound hook removes tool-trace scaffolding; ordinary text unchanged. |
| 6 | What was not tested | Live channel server delivery (no server in this env); the adapter hook itself is exercised directly on the real plugin object. |

## Tests and validation

New `outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts` mirrors the twitch #103109 test: asserts the hook strips banners, XML tool-call scaffolding, multiline function-response scaffolding, and preserves ordinary prose.

## Risk checklist

- [x] One concern, one PR — only the Nostr outbound sanitizeText hook (and the narrowed type that omitted it).
- [x] No config/env/default surface change.
- [x] No SDK/protocol/auth/provider behavior change (reuses an already-exported SDK helper).
- [x] Backward compatible — only internal scaffolding is removed; user-visible prose is unchanged.
- [x] No new deps (helper already in the SDK barrel).
- [x] No CHANGELOG edit (per release policy).
- [x] Tests added.

- [x] Allow edits by maintainers
